item.title: Researching with Generative AI: Empirical Experiences, Methodological Lessons, and Best Practices
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites manuscripts that document real-world experiences of incorporating generative AI into research projects. Rather than focusing on AI as a research subject, the call seeks papers that transparently examine how GenAI functioned within the research methodology itself, transforming practical lessons into broader insights applicable to other scholars.

While the original research need not be published or directly address creativity, innovation, or AI topics, the methodological insights derived must be valuable for researchers working in creativity and innovation management and adjacent fields. The goal is to build a collective understanding of how to effectively and critically use generative AI as a methodological component in academic research.

Appel publié par Creativity and Innovation Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Generative AI as a research tool
  • Methodological applications of GenAI
  • Black box methodology in AI research
  • Research process integration with GenAI
  • Transferable methodological knowledge
  • GenAI in creativity and innovation research

Timeline

  • April 1, 2027: Submission deadline
